;Business and economy 
*[[Tesla, Inc.|Tesla]] stock drops 9% the day after [[Chief executive officer|CEO]] [[Elon Musk]] was seen drinking [[whiskey]] and smoking [[cannabis in California]] while discussing [[space colonization]], life after the [[technological singularity]] and whether [[Simulated reality|reality is a simulation]]  on ''[[The Joe Rogan Experience]]'', and two executives resign. [https://globalnews.ca/news/4435710/elon-musk-weed-tesla-shares-drop/ (AP)] [https://www.space.com/41749-elon-musk-living-in-simulation-rogan-podcast.html (Space.com)]
*[[Starbucks]] opens its first shop in Italy, in the city of [[Milan]]. The 25,000 square-foot Reserve Roastery creates 300 jobs. [https://www.yahoo.com/news/35-years-milan-apos-espresso-111918402.html (''Fortune'' via Yahoo!)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Hokkaido Eastern Iburi earthquake]]
**Energy specialists and executives say a power outage from the earthquake could have been lessened if [[Hokkaido Electric Power Company|Hokkaido Electric]] did not rely so exclusively on the Tomato-Atsuma coal plant. The company has restored electricity to just over half of its affected customers. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-japan-quake-power/power-returning-to-hokkaido-but-quake-exposes-flaws-of-japan-grid-idUSKCN1LN1EM (Reuters)]
*Passengers who were planning on visiting [[Bermuda]] are forced to change plans and go to [[Maine]] and [[Canada]] thanks to a threat of safety posed by [[Hurricane Florence]]. [https://boston.cbslocal.com/2018/09/07/florence-hurricane-norwegian-cruise-ship-bermuda/ (CBS)]

;International relations
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)]]
**[[United States Secretary of Defense|U.S. Defense Secretary]] [[Jim Mattis]] makes an unannounced visit to [[Afghanistan]], to attempt to discuss peace with the [[Taliban]], which has declined such talks with the [[Government of Afghanistan|Afghan government]]. [https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2018/09/07/Mattis-makes-surprise-visit-to-Afghanistan-to-talk-peace-with-Taliban/5581536320752/ (UPI)]
*[[2015–2018 Iraqi protests]]
**Protesters storm the [[Iran]]ian consulate in [[Basra]], in protest of corruption and misrule by Iraq's political elite, damaging the consulate's offices and shouting anti-Iranian slogans while others briefly take workers hostage at a nearby oilfield. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iraq-protests-iran/protesters-storm-iranian-consulate-in-iraqs-basra-idUSKCN1LN20R (Reuters)] [https://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-5343944,00.html (Ynet News)]

;Law and crime
*The [[Ministry of Justice]] of the [[United Kingdom]] announces that divorce laws in [[England and Wales]] will be altered to allow for "no fault" divorces. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-45452146 (BBC)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2018 Malagasy presidential election]]
**[[Madagascar]] [[President of Madagascar|President]] [[Hery Rajaonarimampianina]] resigns from office in order to contest the November presidential election, as required by the [[Constitution of Madagascar|Constitution]]. [[Senate (Madagascar)|Senate]] president {{ill|Riko Rakotovao|fr}} becomes interim [[President of Madagascar]] until the January 2019 inauguration of a new president. [https://www.news24.com/Africa/News/madagascan-president-steps-down-ahead-of-election-20180907 (News24)] [http://www.theeastafrican.co.ke/news/africa/Madagascar-president-resigns-/4552902-4749800-cef07nz/index.html (The East African)]
*[[Mueller special counsel investigation]]
**[[George Papadopoulos]], former [[Donald Trump 2016 presidential campaign|2016 presidential campaign]] aide to [[Donald Trump]], receives a prison sentence of 14 days for lying to investigators regarding [[Links between Trump associates and Russian officials|his ties to Russian contacts]]. He also receives a fine, probation and a community service obligation. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/09/07/politics/george-papadopoulos-sentencing-hearing/index.html (CNN)]
